# Chants of Sennaar AP

An [Archipelago Multiworld](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago) implementation for Chants of Sennaar

- **Status:** Playable alpha, unstable
- **Latest release:** 0.3.1 (Floor 2 + terminals + bugfixes)


## Mod installation guide (Windows)

1. Download the ZIP for [BepInEx 5.4 (win-x64)](https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases).
2. Extract the contents of this ZIP into your Chants of Sennaar game directory.
3. Launch and then close the game. This should initialise BepInEx and create a `BepInEx/plugins` folder in your game directory.
4. Download the ZIP containing the latest release of this mod.
5. Extract the ChantsOfSennaarAP folder into the `BepInEx/plugins` folder inside your game directory.
6. Launch the game. The AP mod menu should now appear on start-up.


## About this AP implementation

What is currently implemented?
- Versions 0.3.x implement Floors 1 and 2 of the tower.

What do the yaml options do?
- In Versions 0.3.x, the `goal_type` is fixed to `journal_hunt` with a `journal_hunt_page_count` ranging from 1 to 10. Any other options selected do not currently affect the behavior of the mod.

What count as "checks" in this game?
- Each new rune observed is one check.
- Each journal page completed is one check.
- Terminal puzzles are planned as optional checks in a future update.

What "items" can you receive?
- Runes, key items, and terminals are implemented as AP items that can be received from the multiworld.

What else is randomized in this game?
- Randomized start locations are planned in a future update.
- Entrance randomization is planned in a future update.
- A language randomization system has been proposed, and may be implemented at a much later stage.


## AI usage disclosure

- This implementation is not vibe-coded.
- This implementation does not contain any AI-generated media assets.
- I have used AI capabilities common to IDEs including inline code completion, proactive error detection, and semantic refactoring. I review all such modifications for intended functionality and syntax before committing any code.
- I have used an AI platform to supplement my understanding of relevant libraries and frameworks, to assist with high-level code review, and to generate helper scripts for automated data gathering based on manually deciphered structures in the base game assets. Any resulting code blocks and data outputs are treated as external references and are never directly reused or integrated in the codebase.
- This mod makes use of files and templates from the [BepInEx modding framework](https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx) and [Archipelago.MultiClient.Net library](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago.MultiClient.Net), including partial reproduction and redistribution of the latter. I cannot personally verify the extent to which these external projects may or may not have used AI in their development.



## Contributing

Bug reports, design suggestions, and other inputs related to this AP implementation are welcome in the Chants of Sennaar thread on the Archipelago Discord server.

notes.text:
Day-one patch for Version 0.3.
Fixes a major apworld issue wherein a large portion of the map is incorrectly marked as in-logic at the start of the game.

Players on active games generated through the v0.3.0 apworld should request server-sending of the following items for correct Sphere 1 access: `Terminal 1`, `Terminal 3`.

All other players and hosts should update to the v0.3.1 apworld as soon as possible.
The v0.3.1 mod is unchanged from the previous release.

### Fixed
- The Abbey Great Door is now marked as passable only if the Terminal 3 puzzle can be solved.
